method: Manual end-to-end passage review of physical3–7 and11–14; physical2/10 boundary context. Not certified word-perfect transcription or a typography census.
analyst_ids: A00–A15/B01–B12 are derivative passage-group labels, not original line numbers.

candidate_relations.limit: Opening coverage differs. Do not force the first Flight12 into the later AA/OP exchange or infer absence from the underlying call.
Earlier A material resembles topics occurring again later in A and in B. No replay, loop, edit, missing call or unique audio alignment is established.
Compare text and interruptions; no native sample or speaker authentication.
Identity words agree in context; source is still a printed representation.
Number-five and passenger/purser readings retained; no preferred wording.
Later Flight12/11 exchange distinct from the B01 opening occurrence.
Speaker-label and question differences retained; no voice match.
Role labels and confirmation/route turns differ; individual identities not reconstructed.
Common medical-contact ending at get; same word is not a native end-of-media or completeness test.
Do not promote playback introduction or post-playback recollection into airborne dialogue.

counts_limit: Groups and relations are analyst navigation units, not counts of calls, speakers, source recordings, edits or independent corroboration.
